description:
Outcome: Runnable foundation enables all first-version journeys (brief.md: First version must; owner delegates technology).
Scope: Django/Python, PostgreSQL, server-rendered HTML/CSS/minimal JavaScript, environment configuration, email adapter, pinned dependencies, migrations, README commands and collected smoke tests. Evaluate hosting/mail/scheduler feasibility including delivery idempotency; establish static collection, /health/ readiness and target browsers. Excludes: features, purchases and deployment during setup.
Acceptance: Local app and isolated PostgreSQL test database start; smoke test collected; development email captured; commands and feasible hosting/mail choices documented.
Behaviour: Clear configuration/connection errors; secrets outside repository; no production email from tests.
Verification: Clean-environment walkthrough, smoke test, health response and captured email. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: approved proposed stack; external credentials obtained before release.
title: Establish application, database and email foundations
